title: Peoples of Russia. Adyghe (Circassians) — Exhibition
description: Exhibition of Adyghe archaeology, period art and crafts alongside work by contemporary Adyghe makers, with the cherkeska and Adyghe Khabze at its centre. Prepared with the National Museum of the Republic of Adygea.

title: Istanbul Circassian Gathering
description: Two-day free festival hosted by İBB Kültür with the Istanbul Caucasian and Abkhaz cultural associations: talks on Xabze, Circassian publishing, cuisine, music and dance; screenings including “1864: Büyük Sürgün ve Soykırım”; concerts, dance groups, workshops and a book fair with some 25 publishers.

title: Circassian March in Berlin for the Right of Return
description: Several dozen Circassians, many in traditional dress, marched through central Berlin with Circassian flags and delivered a demand at the Russian embassy for recognition of their right to return to the historic homeland.
